purpose: Map the v86 child extra-care versus extra-cost demand/friction miss into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system.

mappings.product_miss: The same product has child school-support, VAB, personal-assistance and disability/home-support routes but no explicit normalized truth/regression boundary for omvårdnadsbidrag versus merkostnadsersättning, legacy vårdbidrag wording or the VAB/assistance overlap. A diagnosis-heavy story can therefore become generic guidance or the wrong next step.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Add source-bound NEEDS_REVIEW records for omvårdnadsbidrag and merkostnadsersättning for children, distinguish extra care/supervision from qualifying extra costs, preserve the existing VAB and child-assistance boundaries, understand legacy vårdbidrag wording and keep diagnosis/professional false positives fail-closed. A future public route must reuse the existing family/child flow and same truth layer.
mappings.truth_boundary: Neither diagnosis nor a user's care/cost description is eligibility evidence. Eligibility, duration, thresholds, current amounts, VAB overlap/date rules, assistance overlap, deadlines and application details remain source-verified and review-gated. No raw child/family story, diagnosis, identity, exact cost or medical detail may be copied into feedback or public eval data.
